sections.title: Exceptions: Universal Truths, Historical Facts, Proverbs
sections.content:
कुछ विशेष मामलों में reporting verb past में होने पर भी tense change नहीं होता।

Rule:
1. Reporting verb past पहचानें (said, told)।
2. Check करें कि कथन universal truth, historical fact या proverb है या नहीं।
3. यदि हाँ, तो tense वही रहेगा।
4. Inverted commas हटाकर that लगाएं।

Example (Universal Truth):
Direct: The teacher said, "The earth moves around the sun."
Indirect: The teacher said that the earth moves around the sun.

Example (Proverb):
He said, "Honesty is the best policy." → He said that honesty is the best policy.

sections.title: Mixed Sentences (Statement + Question/Imperative)
sections.content:
एक ही quotation में दो अलग प्रकार के वाक्य हों तो उन्हें अलग-अलग indirect में बदलते हैं।

Rule:
1. पहले sentence का प्रकार पहचानें (assertive, interrogative, imperative)।
2. हर भाग को अलग नियम से बदलें।
3. जरूरत हो तो and से जोड़ें।
4. Pronoun और tense change अलग-अलग apply करें।

Example:
Direct: He said, "I am tired. Can you help me?"
Step 1: I am tired → he was tired.
Step 2: Can you help me? → if I could help him.
Indirect: He said that he was tired and asked if I could help him.

sections.title: Sentences Starting with 'Let'
sections.content:
Let के दो मुख्य प्रयोग होते हैं:

(A) Let us (Suggestion/Proposal)
Rule:
1. suggested/proposed प्रयोग करें।
2. that we should + V1 लगाएं।
Example:
Direct: He said, "Let us go for a walk."
Indirect: He suggested that we should go for a walk.

(B) Let me (Request/Permission)
Rule:
1. requested/asked प्रयोग करें।
2. to + V1 लगाएं।
Example:
Direct: She said, "Let me help you."
Indirect: She requested to help me.

sections.title: Vocatives (Noun of Address)
sections.content:
जब वाक्य में किसी को सीधे संबोधित किया जाए (जैसे Raju, friends), तो उसे object में बदलते हैं।

Rule:
1. Vocative noun पहचानें।
2. said to + noun → told + noun.
3. Imperative हो तो to + V1 लगाएं।

Example:
Direct: He said, "Raju, close the door."
Step 1: Raju object बनेगा।
Step 2: said → told Raju.
Step 3: close → to close.
Indirect: He told Raju to close the door.

sections.title: Advanced Modal Conversions
sections.content:
Modal verbs में विशेष परिवर्तन होते हैं।

Must:
1. Obligation हो तो had to बनेगा।
2. Strong advice हो तो must रह सकता है (context अनुसार)।
Example: He said, "I must finish." → He said that he had to finish.

Need not:
1. need not → did not need to.
Example: She said, "You need not worry." → She said that I did not need to worry.

Had better:
1. had better → advised to.
Example: He said, "You had better rest." → He advised me to rest.

sections.title: सामान्य उच्च स्तरीय गलतियाँ
sections.content:
1. Mixed sentence को एक ही नियम से बदलना।
2. Let us और Let me में भ्रम।
3. Vocative को हटाना भूल जाना।
4. Must को हर बार had to न बनाना (context check जरूरी)।

sections.title: त्वरित सारांश
sections.content:
1. Universal truth में tense change नहीं।
2. Mixed sentences को अलग-अलग convert करें।
3. Let us → suggested that we should।
4. Let me → requested to।
5. Vocative noun को object बनाएं।
6. Modals का अर्थ अनुसार परिवर्तन करें।

tricks.title: Truth Check Trick
tricks.explanation: यदि वाक्य fact या proverb है तो tense मत बदलो।
tricks.example: He said that honesty is the best policy.

tricks.title: Double Sentence Formula
tricks.explanation: Mixed quote दिखे तो पहले full stop खोजो, फिर अलग-अलग बदलो।
tricks.example: He said that he was busy and asked if I could wait.

tricks.title: Let us Shortcut
tricks.explanation: Let us दिखे तो suggested that we should सोचो।
tricks.example: He suggested that we should start.

tricks.title: Let me Shortcut
tricks.explanation: Let me दिखे तो requested to बनाओ।

tricks.title: Vocative पहचानो
tricks.explanation: नाम के बाद comma हो तो उसे object बनाओ।
tricks.example: He told Riya to sit down.

tricks.title: Must Meaning Rule
tricks.explanation: Compulsion हो तो had to, strong rule हो तो must रहने दो।
tricks.example: He said that he had to work hard.

tricks.title: Need not Trick
tricks.explanation: Need not → did not need to।
tricks.example: She said that I did not need to worry.

tricks.title: 4-Step Advanced Formula
tricks.explanation: 1. Sentence type पहचानो 2. Special rule check 3. Pronoun change 4. Tense/Modal adjust 5. Final assertive form बनाओ।
tricks.example: He said that he was ready and requested me to wait.
